proposal.reason: Main change is new host one-sided RMA (PutSignal/Signal/WaitSignal) executed through CE/DMA, including new RMA CE launch logic, signal/ack synchronization, and large-transfer chunking. Enqueue is also substantively changed to add new RMA task types, planner queues, scheduling, and launch-path dispatch. Device-api review is needed for the symmetric window/LSA runtime changes (offset semantics, window validation/capability checks, and communicator property exposure) that directly affect RMA correctness.
